name: act_on_build_computer
description: Drive the app on a build computer: one action, screenshot, click, drag, scroll, type, key, wait, reset. Each but reset is sent to the computer's computer_<action> tool with the fields given, which are the driver's own arguments; reset restores the app's data to its seed with data/reset, which relaunches the app, and returns once the computer is ready again; a screenshot asked of it that then fails leaves the reset done, its result naming why in screenshot_error. Points are pixels of the latest frame, so take a screenshot first, or space norm on a 0..norm_scale grid; count 2 double-clicks; keys names one chord in W3C names, and spellings such as ctrl+s are translated. Returns the driver's content unchanged, its images included, and its structured result; an action's screenshot is taken at once, so after one that opens a menu or a window, take it with a wait instead; a refusal, such as a stale frame, is an error with the computer's message. Each action is logged on the computer. Actions, capture steps and checks on one computer run one at a time, in the order they arrive; computers run side by side.
